# pai notes

List the markdown session notes

```
pai notes [PROJECT] [command] [options]
```

Shows the session notes PAI keeps per project, newest first, optionally for one project.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `PROJECT` | no | Project slug (default: all projects) |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--limit N` | number | 20 | Most notes to show |
| `--status STATE` | string | — | Only notes in this state: open, completed or compacted |

```sh
pai notes
pai notes my-project --status open --limit 5
```

See also: `pai session info`, `pai ls`

### pai notes list

List the markdown session notes (same as `pai notes`)

```
pai notes list [PROJECT] [options]
```

Same as `pai notes`.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `PROJECT` | no | Project slug (default: all projects) |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--limit N` | number | 20 | Most notes to show |
| `--status STATE` | string | — | Only notes in this state: open, completed or compacted |

```sh
pai notes list
pai notes list my-project
```

## Subcommands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `pai notes list` | List the markdown session notes (same as `pai notes`) |
